description: Holds one steady voltage on each polyphonic channel, the channels spread evenly across a range you set

params.text: Rotates the run of voltages through the channels, a whole turn from one end of the travel to the other
Sets where the run of voltages turns around: fully right it rises from the first channel to the last, fully left it falls, and the middle makes a triangle
Bends the spacing of the channels, crowding them towards one end of the range turned one way and towards the other turned the other way; centred they are evenly spaced
Sets how many polyphonic channels the output carries, 1 to 16
Sets the voltage the run starts from, -10V to +10V
Sets how far above the OFF voltage the run reaches, -10V to +10V; the last channel lands on the two added together

inputs.text: Adds to the OFF knob, volt for volt
Adds to the SCL knob, volt for volt
Rotates the run of voltages through the channels, 10V a whole turn; it is added to the Phase knob

outputs.text: One steady voltage per channel, running from the OFF voltage on the first channel to the OFF plus SCL voltage on the last

notes: the voltages here are steady; nothing moves on its own, and the output changes only when a knob is turned or an input voltage changes.
menu: Curve order: Pre (curve, phase, shape), Post (phase, shape, curve) — sets whether the curve is applied to the even spacing before the phase and the shape, or to the result after them
